```{r ast-helpers}
# ============================================================================
# Generic AST-walking helpers, shared by the lineage engine below.
# ============================================================================

# A call with a trailing comma (e.g. `mutate(x = 1, )`) parses to a call
# whose last argument slot holds R's internal "missing argument" marker.
# Touching that value in almost any way -- even just assigning it, or
# passing it to another function -- raises "argument is missing, with no
# default" as soon as it's forced. as.list()ing the call is safe; what's
# NOT safe is looping over the result with `for (a in ...)` or recursing
# into an element without checking first. This drops any such slot before
# the caller ever touches it.
safe_args <- function(x) {
  lst <- as.list(x)
  if (length(lst) <= 1) return(lst[0])
  rest <- lst[-1]
  keep <- vapply(seq_along(rest), function(j) {
    tryCatch({ force(rest[[j]]); TRUE }, error = function(e) FALSE)
  }, logical(1))
  rest[keep]
}

find_calls <- function(e) {
  out <- list()
  rec <- function(x) {
    ok <- tryCatch({ force(x); TRUE }, error = function(e) FALSE)
    if (!ok) return(invisible(NULL))
    if (is.call(x)) {
      out[[length(out) + 1]] <<- x
      for (a in safe_args(x)) rec(a)
    }
  }
  rec(e)
  out
}

# Descend into `{ ... }` blocks and both branches of `if` so that statements
# nested inside them are analyzed just like top-level ones (dcf's caching
# pattern is `if (!identical(old_state, new_state)) { ...write... }`).
flatten_stmts <- function(e) {
  if (is.call(e) && identical(e[[1]], as.name("{"))) {
    return(unlist(lapply(safe_args(e), flatten_stmts), recursive = FALSE))
  }
  if (is.call(e) && identical(e[[1]], as.name("if"))) {
    branches <- safe_args(e)[-1]
    return(unlist(lapply(branches, flatten_stmts), recursive = FALSE))
  }
  list(e)
}

normalize_key <- function(p) sub("^\\./", "", gsub("\\\\", "/", p))

# Dummy definitions used only so match.call() can bind a real call's
# arguments (named or positional) to consistent formal names, regardless of
# whether the call in the script used `vroom::vroom(...)`, `read.csv(...)`,
# etc. -- match.call() matches against `definition`'s formals, not whatever
# function the call itself names.
.dummy_list_files <- function(path, pattern = NULL, full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE, ...) NULL
.dummy_read_file   <- function(file, ...) NULL
.dummy_dcf_staging <- function(staging_dir = "raw/staging", out_dir = "raw", verbose = TRUE,
                                 cleanup = TRUE, standard_names = NULL, ...) NULL
.dummy_write       <- function(x, file, delim = ",", ...) NULL
```

```{r lineage-engine}
# ============================================================================
# The lineage engine: parses one source's ingest.R and returns every
# (standard_file, raw_files) pair it can trace.
# ============================================================================

analyze_source <- function(source_dir) {
  ingest_path <- file.path(source_dir, "ingest.R")
  if (!file.exists(ingest_path)) return(list())

  exprs <- tryCatch(parse(ingest_path, keep.source = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(exprs)) return(list())
  stmts <- unlist(lapply(as.list(exprs), flatten_stmts), recursive = FALSE)

  path_literals <- list()  # var -> literal path string (e.g. "raw/staging_x")
  file_taint    <- list()  # var-or-resolved-literal-key -> character vector of real raw files
  results       <- list()  # accumulated (standard_file, raw_files) sinks

  raw_ish <- function(p) grepl("^\\.{0,2}/?raw", p, ignore.case = TRUE)

  resolve_string <- function(e) {
    if (is.null(e)) return(NULL)
    if (is.character(e)) return(if (length(e) == 1) e else NULL)
    if (is.symbol(e)) return(path_literals[[as.character(e)]])
    if (is.call(e) && identical(e[[1]], as.name("file.path"))) {
      parts <- lapply(safe_args(e), resolve_string)
      if (any(vapply(parts, is.null, logical(1)))) return(NULL)
      return(do.call(file.path, parts))
    }
    NULL
  }

  resolve_and_list <- function(dirpath, pattern) {
    full <- file.path(source_dir, dirpath)
    if (!dir.exists(full)) return(character(0))
    list.files(full, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  }

  extract_standard_names_vec <- function(e) {
    if (is.null(e) || !(is.call(e) && identical(e[[1]], as.name("c")))) return(NULL)
    args <- safe_args(e)
    nms  <- names(args)
    vals <- vapply(args, function(a) if (is.character(a) && length(a) == 1) a else NA_character_, character(1))
    keep <- !is.na(vals) & !is.null(nms) & !is.na(nms) & nzchar(nms)
    if (!any(keep)) return(NULL)
    v <- vals[keep]; names(v) <- nms[keep]
    v
  }

  # Identifiers propagate taint either directly (file_taint[[name]]) or via a
  # resolved literal path that was separately seeded (file_taint[[path]]) --
  # e.g. a variable holding "raw/diabetes_decrypted.csv" whose taint was
  # seeded under that literal key by detect_xlsx_csv_pairs() below.
  taint_of_ids <- function(ids) {
    out <- character(0)
    for (v in ids) {
      if (!is.null(file_taint[[v]])) out <- union(out, file_taint[[v]])
      lit <- path_literals[[v]]
      if (!is.null(lit)) {
        key <- normalize_key(lit)
        if (!is.null(file_taint[[key]])) out <- union(out, file_taint[[key]])
      }
    }
    out
  }

  # Reproduces what dcf::dcf_process_epic_staging() actually does: call the
  # real dcf::dcf_read_epic() on each staged file (with the same
  # standard_names the script passed) to see which output name it routes to,
  # then seed that name's <out_dir>/<name>.csv.xz and .json as fed by every
  # staged file that routed there.
  route_epic_staging <- function(staging_s, out_s, std_names_vec) {
    full_staging <- file.path(source_dir, staging_s)
    if (!dir.exists(full_staging)) return(invisible(NULL))
    staged_files <- sort(list.files(full_staging, "csv", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE))
    staged_files <- staged_files[!grepl("census", staged_files)]
    if (length(staged_files) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
    routed <- vapply(staged_files, function(f) {
      tryCatch(dcf::dcf_read_epic(f, standard_names = std_names_vec)$metadata$standard_name,
               error = function(e) NA_character_)
    }, character(1))
    by_name <- split(staged_files, routed)
    by_name <- by_name[nzchar(names(by_name)) & !is.na(names(by_name))]
    for (nm in names(by_name)) {
      for (ext in c(".csv.xz", ".json")) {
        key <- normalize_key(file.path(out_s, paste0(nm, ext)))
        file_taint[[key]] <<- unname(by_name[[nm]])
      }
    }
  }

  handle_rhs <- function(var, rhs) {
    if (is.character(rhs) && length(rhs) == 1) {
      path_literals[[var]] <<- rhs
      return(invisible(NULL))
    }
    if (is.call(rhs) && identical(rhs[[1]], as.name("file.path"))) {
      resolved <- resolve_string(rhs)
      if (!is.null(resolved)) { path_literals[[var]] <<- resolved; return(invisible(NULL)) }
    }

    set_taint <- character(0)
    for (cl in find_calls(rhs)) {
      head_name <- tryCatch(paste(deparse(cl[[1]]), collapse = ""), error = function(e) "")

      if (head_name == "list.files") {
        mc <- tryCatch(match.call(.dummy_list_files, cl), error = function(e) NULL)
        if (!is.null(mc)) {
          dir_s <- resolve_string(mc$path)
          pat_s <- if (!is.null(mc$pattern)) resolve_string(mc$pattern) else NULL
          if (!is.null(dir_s) && raw_ish(dir_s)) {
            set_taint <- union(set_taint, resolve_and_list(dir_s, pat_s))
          }
        }
      } else if (head_name %in% c("vroom::vroom", "vroom", "read.csv", "read_csv",
                                    "readr::read_csv", "read.delim", "readr::read_delim")) {
        mc <- tryCatch(match.call(.dummy_read_file, cl), error = function(e) NULL)
        if (!is.null(mc)) {
          file_s <- resolve_string(mc$file)
          if (!is.null(file_s)) {
            key <- normalize_key(file_s)
            if (!is.null(file_taint[[key]])) {
              set_taint <- union(set_taint, file_taint[[key]])
            } else if (raw_ish(file_s)) {
              full <- file.path(source_dir, file_s)
              if (file.exists(full)) set_taint <- union(set_taint, full)
            }
          }
        }
      } else if (head_name %in% c("dcf::dcf_process_epic_staging", "dcf_process_epic_staging")) {
        mc <- tryCatch(match.call(.dummy_dcf_staging, cl), error = function(e) NULL)
        if (!is.null(mc)) {
          staging_s <- resolve_string(mc$staging_dir)
          out_s <- if (!is.null(mc$out_dir)) resolve_string(mc$out_dir) else "raw"
          if (!is.null(staging_s)) {
            route_epic_staging(staging_s, out_s, extract_standard_names_vec(mc$standard_names))
          }
        }
      }
    }

    ids <- tryCatch(all.vars(rhs), error = function(e) character(0))
    set_taint <- union(set_taint, taint_of_ids(ids))
    if (length(set_taint) > 0) file_taint[[var]] <<- set_taint
  }

  # General rule (not tied to any one source's variable names): a bare call
  # containing a `list(xlsx = X, csv = Y)`-shaped argument -- the convention
  # used to batch-decrypt password-protected xlsx via Excel COM when
  # msoffcrypto can't -- means the file at Y is downstream of the raw xlsx
  # at X, so Y inherits X's taint.
  detect_xlsx_csv_pairs <- function(e) {
    for (cl in find_calls(e)) {
      if (identical(cl[[1]], as.name("list"))) {
        args <- safe_args(cl)
        nms <- names(args)
        if (!is.null(nms) && "xlsx" %in% nms && "csv" %in% nms) {
          xlsx_s <- resolve_string(args[[which(nms == "xlsx")]])
          csv_s  <- resolve_string(args[[which(nms == "csv")]])
          if (!is.null(xlsx_s) && !is.null(csv_s) && raw_ish(xlsx_s)) {
            full_xlsx <- file.path(source_dir, xlsx_s)
            if (file.exists(full_xlsx)) file_taint[[normalize_key(csv_s)]] <<- full_xlsx
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  detect_write_sink <- function(e) {
    for (cl in find_calls(e)) {
      head_name <- tryCatch(paste(deparse(cl[[1]]), collapse = ""), error = function(e) "")
      if (head_name %in% c("vroom::vroom_write", "vroom_write", "write_csv",
                             "readr::write_csv", "write.csv")) {
        mc <- tryCatch(match.call(.dummy_write, cl), error = function(e) NULL)
        if (is.null(mc)) next
        dest_s <- resolve_string(mc$file)
        if (is.null(dest_s)) next
        dest_s <- normalize_key(dest_s)
        if (!grepl("^standard/", dest_s)) next
        ids <- tryCatch(all.vars(e), error = function(e) character(0))
        results[[length(results) + 1]] <<- list(standard_file = dest_s, raw_files = taint_of_ids(ids))
      }
    }
  }

  for (e in stmts) {
    if (is.call(e) && length(e) == 3 && as.character(e[[1]])[1] %in% c("<-", "=", "<<-") && is.symbol(e[[2]])) {
      handle_rhs(as.character(e[[2]]), e[[3]])
    } else {
      detect_write_sink(e)
      detect_xlsx_csv_pairs(e)
    }
  }

  results
}
```

```{r meta-readers}
# ============================================================================
# Read Session Date Range + Date of Export straight out of a raw file.
# ============================================================================

read_header_rows <- function(path, n = 20) {
  tryCatch(
    read.csv(path, header = FALSE, nrows = n, colClasses = "character",
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE),
    error = function(e) tryCatch(
      read.csv(path, header = FALSE, nrows = n, colClasses = "character",
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "windows-1252"),
      error = function(e2) NULL
    )
  )
}

label_value <- function(header_df, label, value_col = 2) {
  if (is.null(header_df) || ncol(header_df) < value_col) return(NA_character_)
  hit <- which(trimws(as.character(header_df[[1]])) == label)
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  trimws(as.character(header_df[hit[1], value_col]))
}

# Strip a trailing annotation like "(Based On Arrival Date)" so the range
# column holds just the two dates.
clean_range <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), x, trimws(sub("\\s*\\(.*\\)\\s*$", "", x)))

meta_plain_csv <- function(path) {
  rows <- read_header_rows(path)
  list(session_date_range = clean_range(label_value(rows, "Session Date Range")),
       date_of_export      = label_value(rows, "Date of Export"))
}

decrypt_xlsx <- function(path, password) {
  decrypted <- tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx")
  cmd <- sprintf('python -m msoffcrypto -p "%s" "%s" "%s"',
                 password, normalizePath(path, winslash = "/"), decrypted)
  status <- suppressWarnings(system(cmd, ignore.stdout = TRUE, ignore.stderr = TRUE))
  if (status != 0 || !file.exists(decrypted)) return(NULL)
  decrypted
}

meta_xlsx <- function(path, password = Sys.getenv("EPIC_XLSX_PASSWORD")) {
  na_result <- list(session_date_range = NA_character_, date_of_export = NA_character_)
  if (!file.exists(path) || !nzchar(password)) return(na_result)
  decrypted <- tryCatch(decrypt_xlsx(path, password), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(decrypted)) return(na_result)
  on.exit(unlink(decrypted), add = TRUE)
  rows <- tryCatch({
    wb <- openxlsx2::wb_load(decrypted)
    openxlsx2::wb_to_df(wb, sheet = 1, col_names = FALSE, skip_empty_rows = FALSE,
                         skip_empty_cols = FALSE, rows = 1:20)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(rows)) return(na_result)
  rows <- as.data.frame(lapply(rows, function(x) { x <- as.character(x); x[is.na(x)] <- ""; x }))
  list(session_date_range = clean_range(label_value(rows, "Session Date Range")),
       date_of_export      = label_value(rows, "Date of Export"))
}

read_meta <- function(path) if (grepl("\\.xlsx$", path, ignore.case = TRUE)) meta_xlsx(path) else meta_plain_csv(path)
```

```{r discover}
# ============================================================================
# Discover sources (excluding bundle_cosmos, which has no raw/ of its own),
# run the lineage engine on each, and detect stale standard files.
# ============================================================================

discover_standard_files <- function(dir) {
  list.files(file.path("data", dir, "standard"), pattern = "\\.csv(\\.gz)?$", full.names = FALSE)
}

all_dirs    <- list.dirs("data", full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE)
source_dirs <- all_dirs[grepl("^cosmos_", all_dirs)]

engine_results <- lapply(source_dirs, function(s) analyze_source(file.path("data", s)))
names(engine_results) <- source_dirs

own_lineage <- bind_rows(lapply(source_dirs, function(s) {
  bind_rows(lapply(engine_results[[s]], function(r) {
    if (length(r$raw_files) == 0) return(NULL)
    tibble(source = s, standard_file = r$standard_file, raw_file = r$raw_files)
  }))
}))
if (nrow(own_lineage) == 0) own_lineage <- tibble(source = character(), standard_file = character(), raw_file = character())

stale_own <- bind_rows(lapply(source_dirs, function(s) {
  on_disk <- discover_standard_files(s)
  found   <- basename(unique(own_lineage$standard_file[own_lineage$source == s]))
  missing <- setdiff(on_disk, found)
  if (length(missing) == 0) return(NULL)
  tibble(source = s, standard_file = file.path("standard", missing), raw_file = NA_character_,
         note = "Not produced by the current ingest.R -- no write of this file was found while parsing the script, so this is likely a leftover from an earlier version with no traceable raw-file lineage.")
}))

all_detail <- bind_rows(
  own_lineage %>% mutate(note = NA_character_),
  stale_own
)

# Auto-detect reuse: the same raw file feeding more than one standard file
# within a source gets a note instead of being silently duplicated.
reuse_note <- all_detail %>%
  filter(!is.na(raw_file)) %>%
  distinct(source, standard_file, raw_file) %>%
  group_by(source, raw_file) %>%
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
  summarize(other = paste(unique(basename(standard_file)), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop")

all_detail <- all_detail %>%
  left_join(reuse_note, by = c("source", "raw_file")) %>%
  mutate(note = case_when(
    !is.na(note)  ~ note,
    !is.na(other) ~ paste0("Also feeds: ", other),
    TRUE          ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  select(-other)
```

```{r resolve}
meta <- all_detail %>%
  filter(!is.na(raw_file)) %>%
  distinct(raw_file) %>%
  mutate(m = map(raw_file, read_meta),
         session_date_range = map_chr(m, "session_date_range"),
         date_of_export      = map_chr(m, "date_of_export")) %>%
  select(-m)

detail <- all_detail %>% left_join(meta, by = "raw_file")
```

## Standard files with corresponding raw files and date range

```{r detail-table}
detail %>%
  transmute(
    Source              = source,
    `Standard file`      = standard_file,
    `Raw file`           = coalesce(basename(raw_file), "(none -- see note)"),
    `Session Date Range` = coalesce(session_date_range, "unavailable"),
    `Date of Export`     = coalesce(date_of_export, "unavailable"),
    Note                 = coalesce(note, "")
  ) %>%
  arrange(Source, `Standard file`) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Source, `Standard file`), ~ if_else(duplicated(cur_data()[c("Source", "Standard file")]), "", .x))) %>%
  kable()
```
